_source: argenx SE Annual Report 2024 (Euronext Brussels primary)

kpis.description_fr: Ventes Vyvgart/Vyvgart Hytrulo (efgartigimod, FcRn antagonist) FY24. Lancement 2022 myasthénie généralisée + 2024 CIDP/ITP. Premier blockbuster argenx.
kpis.description_en: Vyvgart/Vyvgart Hytrulo (efgartigimod, FcRn antagonist) sales FY24. 2022 launch generalized myasthenia + 2024 CIDP/ITP. argenx first blockbuster.

kpis.description_fr: Patients traités cumulés Vyvgart FY24. Indicateur adoption commerciale réelle (gMG, CIDP). Pipeline élargissement géographique 30+ pays.
kpis.description_en: Cumulative Vyvgart patients FY24. Real commercial adoption indicator (gMG, CIDP). Pipeline 30+ country geographic expansion.

kpis.description_fr: R&D FY24 (~50% du CA). Intensité élevée = signature biotech innovation phase. Pipeline 8 indications efgartigimod + 5 nouveaux mAbs.
kpis.description_en: FY24 R&D (~50% of revenue). High intensity = biotech innovation phase signature. Efgartigimod 8 indications pipeline + 5 new mAbs.

kpis.description_fr: Indications cliniques actives FY24 (efgartigimod + ARGX-119, ARGX-213). Stratégie pipeline-in-a-product (FcRn).
kpis.description_en: Active clinical indications FY24 (efgartigimod + ARGX-119, ARGX-213). Pipeline-in-a-product strategy (FcRn).

kpis.description: Indications FDA/EMA approuvées : gMG, CIDP, ITP (Japon). Plan label expansion.
kpis.explanation: Premier blockbuster en autoimmun pour argenx.
kpis.explanation_en: First blockbuster autoimmune drug for argenx.

kpis.description: Trésorerie + equivalents argenx. Funding ample pour Phase 3 + commercialization.
kpis.explanation: Plus de cash que la plupart des biotechs en commercialisation.
kpis.explanation_en: More cash than most biotechs at commercialization stage.

kpis.signal: Vyvgart = blockbuster argenx, +83% FY24. Premiere therapie FcRn approuvee gMG + CIDP.
kpis.description_fr: Ventes nettes produit VYVGART (efgartigimod IV + HYTRULO SC). Premier inhibiteur FcRn approuve gMG (myasthenie grave) + CIDP. Blockbuster argenx.
kpis.description_en: VYVGART (efgartigimod IV + HYTRULO SC) product net sales. First FcRn inhibitor approved gMG + CIDP. Argenx blockbuster.

kpis.signal: 10 000+ patients gMG sous VYVGART fin 2024. Trajectoire vers 50 000 patients d'ici 2030 (objectif declaré).
kpis.description_fr: Patients gMG (myasthenie grave generalisee) traites avec VYVGART. Indicateur adoption commerciale, cible 2030 = 50 000.
kpis.description_en: Generalized myasthenia gravis patients treated with VYVGART. Adoption metric, 2030 target = 50,000.

kpis.signal: ~1 000 patients CIDP sous VYVGART HYTRULO fin 2024. Indication CIDP approuvee 2024, marche potentiel >25 000 patients US.
kpis.description_fr: Patients CIDP (polyradiculoneuropathie inflammatoire chronique demyelinisante) traites avec VYVGART HYTRULO. Indication approuvee 2024.
kpis.description_en: CIDP (chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy) patients on VYVGART HYTRULO. Indication approved 2024.

kpis.signal: 5 candidats pipeline en Phase 3 (objectif declare 2030). Empasiprubart inhibiteur C2, et indications VYVGART supplementaires.
kpis.description_fr: Candidats du pipeline argenx avances en developpement Phase 3. Inclut empasiprubart + nouvelles indications VYVGART.
kpis.description_en: Argenx pipeline candidates advanced into Phase 3 development. Includes empasiprubart + additional VYVGART indications.

kpis_story.description_fr: Stratégie Vision 2030 : 5 indications Vyvgart approuvées + 5K patients/indication. Pyramide pipeline (Phase 3 ongoing : sjogren, lupus, myositis, ITP labels expansion).
kpis_story.description_en: Vision 2030 strategy: 5 approved Vyvgart indications + 5K patients/indication. Pipeline pyramid (Phase 3 ongoing: sjogren, lupus, myositis, ITP label expansions).

_notes: Belgian biotech autoimmune leader. Source: AR FY24.
